policies.title: Policy
policies.saved: Saved. Nothing changes on a device until you sign it with hauswart-admin approve.
policies.forbiddenHint: Removing a package can take what depends on it along.
policies.filesHint: Only paths the device allows in its agent.json. Anything else shows up as a deviation.
policies.casHint: A device trusts these for as long as they are in its policy.
policies.updatesOn: Install updates in a maintenance window

rebootRule.window: Restart in the window when needed

policies.screenTimeHint: Outside these times the session ends, and unsaved work is lost. A day without a time means no session on that day.
policies.quotaAllDay: No windows: any time of the day, up to the minutes per day.
policies.noWindows: No windows and no minutes: no session at all.

errors.policy_too_large: The policy has too many entries or is larger than {{value}} KiB.
errors.package_protected: {{value}} cannot be forbidden, the device depends on it.
errors.invalid_time_zone: The time zone is missing or not valid: {{value}}
errors.invalid_reboot: The restart rule is not valid: {{value}}
errors.invalid_window: The time window is not valid: {{value}}
errors.invalid_extension: An extension needs an end at most {{value}} from now.
